VBO:0200325.summary: The Chesador is a Labrador Retriever–Chesapeake Bay Retriever cross. The name appears in a breeder’s 2011 account of a brown litter in Minnesota; a Michigan program later described its own black puppies with rippled coats. These records show variation within the named cross, rather than a single required color or a predictable temperament.
VBO:0200325.shortDescription: A Labrador–Chesapeake Bay Retriever cross, documented in brown and black litters with variation in coat.
